status: frozen; implemented in prompt mannercap.intake.v3 (basis request_scope + code-side scope check) before any live v3 call
rules: R1 A speed request with no object and no stage ('go slowly', 'move slowly') applies to every motion stage of the program that supports speed control. It is not an ambiguity.

R2 A request that names a stage ('when approaching') applies to that stage of every manipulated object named or implied by the task ('both ...'); a request that names an object applies to that object's stages. The narrower scope overrides the global one on the stages it covers.
R3 A global speed request does not change grip force or press level (dimensions are independent).

R4 Clarification is required only when requests on the same stage and dimension contradict each other, or the referent of a pronoun/quantifier ('it', 'one of them') cannot be resolved. Grip/press requests without an object remain ambiguous when several grasps exist (v1 behaviour kept).
R5 A stage that the request covers but that has no speed control must be reported as a limitation, never skipped silently.

B06.note: consequence of R2 (stage named, objects given by 'both'); needs owner confirmation

evaluation: revised gold is applied only with `s6_intake_eval.py --protocol v2` on the existing cached model outputs; outputs of the v1 prompt are not expected to follow R1/R2, so those cases are reported as protocol-revised, not as model errors. Original gold and results are kept.

freeze.plan: dev live (--protocol v2 --tag _v3) then acceptance once; no prompt edits between or after; results reported as subset excluding disputed and protocol-revised cases, revised cases reported separately
